🇺🇸🇮🇷 <u>US STRIKES IRANIAN ISLAND OF QESHM — CEASEFIRE BROKEN, PEACE TALKS HALT</u>

CENTCOM bombed an IRGC ground-control station on Qeshm Island today, claiming it intercepted Iranian missiles and drones aimed at Kuwait and Bahrain. CENTCOM statement: "American forces responded with strikes on Qeshm Island. No U.S. personnel or assets were damaged."

The IRGC said it hit the US 5th Fleet center in Bahrain and an airbase in retaliation. The 60-day extended ceasefire — the one Vance pushed last month — is effectively over. Indirect peace talks have halted; Trump's "deal in days" line has expired.

26 ships through Hormuz yesterday. The blockade still isn't holding.

Source: Regeneración

🇲🇽🌎 <u>WMO PUTS EL NIÑO ODDS AT 80% FOR JUNE-AUGUST, RISING ABOVE 90% INTO NOVEMBER</u>

The World Meteorological Organization reports an 80% probability of El Niño June-August 2026, climbing above 90% through July-November. Niño 3.4 region surface temperatures are already 0.47°C above the historic average; subsurface Pacific waters exceed normal by more than 6°C.

La Niña is now off the table. The forecast intensity range: moderate to strong. Mexican rainfall, crop yields, and the 12-18 month food-price cycle all run downstream of this. The 2030 record-warm-year probability sits at 86%.

Climate isn't a forecast anymore. It's a balance sheet.

Source: Contralínea

🇲🇽🩺 <u>ISSSTE OPENS 4 "CUARTOS AZULES" — 400,000 MAMMOGRAMS A YEAR, AI-READ, NO WOMAN HAS TO CARRY HER OWN IMAGING PLATE</u>

ISSSTE launched four AI-assisted diagnostic centers — in CDMX (Hospital Adolfo López Mateos), Tlajomulco (Jalisco), Susulá (Yucatán) and Torreón (Coahuila) — that will interpret 400,000 mammography studies per year remotely from 98 hospitals, expanding to 180 medical units by 2027.

Director Martí Batres: "Las mujeres ya no tendrán que llevar su placa a otro lugar para que se la interpreten" — info is sent electronically and read back to the originating clinic.

Six reading stations per center. A fifth is in the pipeline. This is what public health-tech looks like when it isn't run for profit.

Source: Contralínea

🚨🇲🇽 <u>US SILENTLY REVOKED VISAS OF TWO MORENA GOVERNORS — THEN LET THEM BACK IN ON "PAROLE"</u>

LA Times: the US cancelled the visas of Alfonso Durazo (Sonora) and Américo Villarreal (Tamaulipas), then re-admitted both under "significant public benefit parole" — a status normally given to witnesses or collaborators in US investigations. Tamaulipas probe centers on huachicol; Durazo on alleged ties to organized crime.

Both state governments call the report "completamente falso." Sheinbaum's response: "¿Cuál es el interés?" — and pointed to sectors of the US ultra-right working to defame the Fourth Transformation.

The visa is a leash. The "parole" is the proof.

Source: La Jornada

🚨🇲🇽 <u>SAME DAY US LEAKS "INVESTIGATIONS" INTO MORENA GOVERNORS, MEXICO ENACTS LAW TO ANNUL ELECTIONS HIT BY FOREIGN INTERFERENCE</u>

Three constitutional reforms entered into force today after DOF publication: nullity of elections by foreign interference (Article 41), verification of candidate integrity, and rescheduling of the judicial vote to June 4, 2028. Luisa María Alcalde framed them as "reformas para fortalecer nuestra democracia."

The Senate pushed Article 41 through in 16 hours last week. The LA Times dropped the Durazo–Villarreal "investigation" leak this morning. Timing.

Source: La Jornada

COUNTERPUNCH: What Claudia Sheinbaum Has Achieved for Mexico
June 3, 2026 | 🟢

📰 Rare fair US coverage. Eve Ottenberg at CounterPunch lists what mainstream press won't: women's pension 60-64, universal student scholarships, in-home healthcare outreach, constitutional social rights, pay equity guidelines, housing reform. A welfare state being built — while NYT runs "cartel made the state its tool." 🇲🇽

Mainstream US press has spent the past 7 days on indictments, tariff threats, and tunnel raids. Zero coverage of the actual policy substance happening in Mexico City.

• "These are not minute or insignificant contributions to the well-being of ordinary people"
• "good is so weak in the world that it deserves praise wherever it's bold enough to act"

AP/KSAT: US plans extra 10% tariffs on most trading partners after forced labor probe
June 3, 2026 | 🔴

📰 Trump proposes 10% tariff on Mexico, Canada, EU, UK over "forced labor." Mexico — which raised minimum wages 135% under AMLO+Sheinbaum and constitutionally enshrined labor rights — lumped in as a labor abuser. USMCA partner = adversary. 💀🇲🇽

A trade lawyer admits the play out loud: "politically it's very hard to argue you shouldn't go after forced labor." Section 301 is the workaround after the Supreme Court limited Trump's direct tariff powers. The labor rationale is the cover; the lever is the goal.

• USTR Greer: "the failure of our most important trading partners to address the importation of goods made with forced labor is unacceptable"
• EU's Lange: "Accusing EU of not doing enough against forced labour is absurd"

BREITBART: Mexican President Tells US Ambassador to Butt Out Regarding Narco-Politicians
June 2, 2026 | 🔴

📰 Breitbart's headline calls the Morena governor a "narco-politician" — DOJ allegations rebranded as proven fact. Sheinbaum "lashes out," "rushes to defend." The right-wing wire's banana-republic memo, Ortiz & Darby byline. 🤡

What the piece omits: the indictment is unproven, the CIA raid in Chihuahua happened on Mexican soil without authorization, and the timing — months before Mexico's 2027 elections — was set by Washington, not Mexico City.

• Headline frame: "narco-politicians"
• Sheinbaum reduced to: Mexico's issues "were for Mexicans to handle"
• Johnson sanitized: "the fight against cartels should unite and not divide the people"

LATIN TIMES: US Ambassador "pushes back on Sheinbaum sovereignty warning"
June 2, 2026 | 🟡

📰 Latin Times headline: a sovereign president defending her country's institutions becomes a "sovereignty warning" that the US ambassador has to "push back" against. Sovereignty itself is the provocation. 🇲🇽🔍

Ambassador Johnson's "every moment spent turning this into a political dispute is a missed opportunity" repackages a foreign envoy publicly commenting on Mexican domestic affairs as the cooperative position.

• "Mexico is nobody's piñata" — Sheinbaum
• "when from abroad they dictate who is guilty and who is not, when they seek to pressure our institutions from outside, we are no longer talking about cooperation, we are talking about interference"

REUTERS: Mexico's Sheinbaum escalates rhetoric against US, blames far-right "offensive"
June 2, 2026 | 🟡

📰 Reuters: Sheinbaum "escalates rhetoric" — not the DOJ indicting her party allies before 2027 elections, not the CIA raid in Chihuahua, not Trump's troop threats. The president responds and that's the escalation. 🔍🇲🇽

The actual escalator chain — unauthorized CIA raid in Chihuahua, SDNY indictment of a Morena governor, US ambassador posting publicly about "narco-politicians" — vanishes into one passive phrase about "rising tensions."

• "sectors of the US far right positioning themselves ahead of their 2026 elections"
• "we do not accept interference"
